description: A shell script containing tests for Git sparse checkout functionality, focusing on 'git add' behavior with sparse entries, index updates, and sparse checkout configurations.

methods.name: setup_sparse_entry
methods.description: Prepares a sparse entry in the Git index, optionally writing a format string to the sparse_entry file.

methods.name: test_sparse_entry_unchanged
methods.description: Verifies that the sparse_entry's blob hash remains unchanged in the index.

methods.name: setup_gitignore
methods.description: Sets up a .gitignore file to ignore all files except sparse_entry.

methods.name: test_sparse_entry_unstaged
methods.description: Checks that sparse_entry is unstaged (not staged for commit).
